description_en: Queries a specified data source by data source ID
description_zh: 根据数据源ID，查询指定的数据源
name: GetDataSource

parameters.help_en: The data source ID, which is the unique identifier of the data source
parameters.help_zh: 数据源ID，数据源的唯一标识符
parameters.name: id

ConnectionProperties.description_en:
The connection configuration of the data source, including the endpoint, access identity, and environment context. The data source environment type (envType) is a member property of this object. Valid values:
Dev: development environment.
Prod: production environment.

Different types of data sources have different property specifications under different configuration modes (ConnectionPropertiesMode). For more information, see [Data source connection properties (ConnectionProperties)]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852465.html）
ConnectionProperties.description_zh:
数据源的具体连接配置信息，包括连接地址、访问身份、环境信息等。数据源环境envType信息是此对象的成员属性，包括
Dev（开发环境）
Prod（生产环境）

不同类型的数据源在不同的配置模式（ConnectionPropertiesMode）下具有不同的属性信息规范，请参考[数据源连接信息ConnectionProperties]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852465.html）

ConnectionPropertiesMode.description_en:
The category in which the data source is added. Different types have different subtypes with different parameter constraints. Examples:
InstanceMode: instance mode.
UrlMode: connection string mode.
CdhMode: CDH mode
ConnectionPropertiesMode.description_zh:
数据源添加的类别，不同type下会有不同的子类型，对应有不同的参数约束，场景举例：
InstanceMode 实例模式；
UrlMode 连接串模式；
CdhMode：CDH模式

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the data source was created (timestamp)
CreateTime.description_zh: 数据源的创建时间（时间戳）

CreateUser.description_en: The ID of the user who created the data source

Description.description_en: The description of the data source

Id.description_en: The ID of the data source

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the data source was last modified (timestamp)
ModifyTime.description_zh: 数据源的最近修改时间（时间戳）

ModifyUser.description_en: The ID of the user who last modified the data source

Name.description_en: The name of the data source

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the data source belongs
ProjectId.description_zh: 数据源所属的项目空间ID

QualifiedName.description_en: The business unique key of the data source. For example, the format for a Hologres data source is `${tenantOwnerId}:${regionId}:${type}:${instanceId}:${database}`
QualifiedName.description_zh: 数据源的业务唯一键，以holo举例格式是`${tenantOwnerId}:${regionId}:${type}:${instanceId}:${database}`

Type.description_en: The type of the data source

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used for locating logs and troubleshooting issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志，排查问题
